summary: The patch rounds the float instead of truncating it. That makes 19.99 and 0.29 come out right, but money still goes through a float: amounts with three decimals (1.005) or exponents (1e3) are silently rounded or accepted instead of rejected, amounts beyond float precision lose cents, and JSON number amounts still pass. Parsing the string exactly (digits and up to two decimals, or Decimal with validation) is the fix.

issue_groups.label: Still converts money through a float
Silently accepts or rounds malformed amounts
Only the happy-path values are tested
